spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (-तीवति)
To be large, to be fat or corpulent.

m. (-रः)
1 The ocean.
2 A hunter, one who lives by killing and selling game.
3 A fisherman, one who lives by fishing.
f. (-री)
The wife of a hunter.
E.
तॄ to go, to pass or cross, ष्वरच् aff.

mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं)
1 Much, excessive, endless, unbounded, unlimited.
2

Hot, warm.
m. (-व्रः)
A name of ŚIVA.
f. (-व्रा)
1 A medicinal plant,

Black mustard.
3 A sort of Dūrvā or bent grass, (गण्डदूर्व्वा)
4 The name of a river in the east of Bengal; also the Caṇḍī or Padmāvatī.
adv. n. (-व्रं)
1 Much, excessively, endless.
2 Violently, fiercely.
subst.
1 A shore, a bank.
2

Pungency.
E.
तीव to be large, &c. रक् aff.

f. (-ना)
Agony, excessive pain, the pain of damnation.
E.
तीव्र exceeding, and वेदना pain.
